newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary central budget shows surplus in September. [CORRECTED 15:54 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hungary central budget shows surplus in September. [CORRECTED 15:54 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects the month in the headline to September from August.)

Hungary's central state budget showed a surplus in September, compared with a deficit of 19 billion dollars in August, Finance Ministry State Secretary Csaba Laszlo told a news conference on Wednesday.
Csaba said the Ministry will publish the amount of the surplus later. Hungary's budget deficit amounted to 121 billion forints in August.

Csaba said Hungary's general government deficit, including the central state budget, local municipalities and state funds, is likely to post a 1996 deficit of four percent of the gross domestic product, as targeted.
